subject: [Renewal] CI & Artifact Add-ons: ContainerNexus + Buildkite agents
messages:
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: CI / Artifact add-ons renewal — quick sync and negotiation plan

Hi team,

ContainerNexus and Buildkite agent licenses are both up for renewal July 1. I pulled the renewal notices and the quick facts: ContainerNexus wants a one-year renewal for their "standard registry + geo-replication" add-on at $72k/year (same list price as last year), and Buildkite has proposed a 20% uplift for their managed agent pool versus our current committed rate.

Ask: can we scope a 30-minute sync tomorrow to align on negotiation levers (multi-year commit, usage caps, alternate SKUs) and decide who should own the external conversation? I suggest: Ben to drive the ContainerNexus negotiation (you know their AM), Karthik to take Buildkite pricing, Avery to own procurement/compliance sign-off, Laura to approve any >$50k exceptions.

I attached the two renewal quotes I received. Please review the attached pricing and reply with availability for a 30-min slot.

Thanks,
Dev

--
Dev Patel
FinOps / Procurement Lead
Redwood Inference

On Mon, Apr 20, 2026 at 09:15 AM Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai> wrote:
> ContainerNexus and Buildkite agent licenses are both up for renewal July 1...

I can take the ContainerNexus thread. Jorge Ramos (AM) has been responsive in the past — CC'ing him below so we can get a formal line itemized quote. My approach: request a 15% discount for a 12-month renewal, ask for waived onboarding fees for the new geo-replication node we plan to add, and push for an SLA credit clause. If they're stiff, we push a short-term 3-month extension at current pricing while we explore alternatives.

Available tomorrow 10:30-11:00 or 2:00-2:30.

Ben

Date: Tue, 21 Apr 2026 08:44:00 -0700

Hi Ben / Dev —

Thanks for the heads-up. Attached is the formal renewal quote from ContainerNexus (ContainerNexus_renewal_quote_Q1-2026.pdf). Summary:
- Standard registry + geo-replication add-on: $72,000/yr
- Multi-year discount: 8% for 2-year term, 12% for 3-year term
- Onboarding fee: $3,000 if adding a new replication node (waivable with 3-year term)
- SLA credit: available subject to legal review

If you want, I can hold current pricing for 30 days while you decide. Would you like a revised quote with a 2-year or 3-year option and the onboarding fee waived?

Regards,
Jorge Ramos
Enterprise Account Manager
ContainerNexus

Attachment: ContainerNexus_renewal_quote_Q1-2026.pdf (application/pdf, 145KB)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Buildkite Sales <sales@buildkite.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Apr 2026 10:11:00 -0700
Subject: Buildkite agent pricing — request for clarification

Hi Buildkite team,

We received the preliminary pricing sheet (buildkite_agent_pricing_sheet.xlsx) indicating a proposed 20% uplift for our managed agent pool. Two quick clarifications before we proceed:
1) Is the uplift applied to committed agent-hours only, or to total usage?
2) Can you confirm whether auto-scaling bursts are billed at the same rate as committed capacity?

We prefer a model that separates committed baseline from burst usage with predictable unit pricing. If you can provide a 12-month vs 24-month pricing option and any available volume discounts, that will help our decision.

Thanks — Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Senior SRE, CI Platform
Redwood Inference
From: Buildkite Sales <sales@buildkite.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 23 Apr 2026 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Buildkite agent pricing — clarification and options

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the questions. Quick answers:
- The 20% uplift in our initial sheet was on committed agent-hours only. Burst auto-scale is billed separately at list rate (no uplift), but we can offer a blended cap if you commit to a monthly minimum.
- We can provide a 12-month vs 24-month tier with discounts (8% for 12m, 14% for 24m) and a blended pricing option to cap bursts.

I'll prepare a revised sheet with (a) committed baseline + burst cap, (b) a blended option, and (c) an optional 2-year contract that waives onboarding for additional agents. Expect that by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Erin Malloy
Commercial Operations
Buildkite

Attachment: buildkite_agent_pricing_sheet.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 24KB)
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Jorge Ramos <jorge.ramos@containernexus.com>, Erin Malloy <sales@buildkite.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2026 17:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CI / Artifact add-ons renewal — next steps and procurement request

Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. Summary / proposed next steps:

- ContainerNexus: Ben will ask Jorge for a revised quote with a 2-year option (8% off) and waived onboarding fee. If Jorge can include a 30-day price hold, we'll accept conditional approval.
- Buildkite: Karthik to confirm the blended cap option and request the 24-month discount (14%). If Buildkite can cap bursts and provide a blended rate within 10% of our current effective cost, we prefer a 24-month term.
- Procurement: Avery, please confirm required security/compliance documentation (SOC 2 attestation, data retention policy) and open a PO request template.
- Approval: Laura, please confirm if we can proceed with approvals up to $75k/year without a formal finance escalation. Anything above that will require a larger review.

I've uploaded the two vendor quotes and a short negotiation playbook to the shared doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1sdf-example-MAP. Once Buildkite and ContainerNexus provide revised quotes, I'll prepare the procurement packet and send for your signature.

If nobody objects, Ben and Karthik will run the vendor negotiation threads directly and loop back here with revised attachments.

Appreciate the quick responses — target to close both renewals by June 15 to lock pricing and avoid July churn.

Best,
Dev

--
Dev Patel
FinOps / Procurement Lead
Redwood Inference
